description: End-to-end integration fixtures for Component 4. Each case pairs a user question with the SQL Member 1 would generate for it (hand-written here, tenant-scoped as Member 3 would enforce). The SQL runs against the synthetic MySQL database through member2_stub, and the masked result is fed to the Component 4 pipeline. Expectations were written from the intent and response-shape definitions, NOT by running the classifier, so they test it rather than describe it. Where a phrasing is genuinely ambiguous, every defensible label is listed.

expectation_keys.response_intent: acceptable output shapes (ResponseIntent); null = not checked
expectation_keys.forecast: SHOWN = forecast generated AND visible to the user; REFUSED = no forecast AND the reason is visible to the user; ANSWERED = either SHOWN or REFUSED; NONE = no forecast appears in the response; OPTIONAL = not checked (trend questions receive an implicit forecast by design)
expectation_keys.warnings_include: warning codes the envelope must contain

case_keys.truth_series: when set, the SQL returns the tenant's full monthly series of this table, so detected anomalies are scored against the injected ones in output/ground_truth.json
